_readme: Business segments of handbook Tables 10 and 11 (Individual Business in force), in the
Why this exists: those tables repeat the same metrics once per business segment. Our
extractor met the same row label 16 times, numbered the repeats _2 .. _9 to keep ids
unique, and DISCARDED the segment heading - the only thing telling them apart. Every
numbered row was then stamped with the FIRST segment's name, so eight segments of
in-force business all read 'Non Linked Life Business'.
Mapping is positional: a metric_id ending _N is the Nth segment here. Segment 1 and
segments 10-16 both sit under the UN-numbered id and are told apart by their class of
business, which extracted correctly for those - so only _2.._9 need relabelling.
Verified against the original workbook on (insurer, year, metric, segment):
An earlier run reported 89%. That was the CHECK, which kept one value per metric id
when the un-numbered id holds several segments. A separate off-by-one was caught here
too: Table 10's unit subtitle '(Number of Policies in 000s)' was being counted as a
segment, which would have shifted every mapping by one.
Positional, so valid only for the 2024-25 layout. Re-verify before reusing on a future
source: IRDAI Handbook 2024-25, Part I, Tables 10 and 11
